LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_INTRO_DESCRI.translation: Synchronization connects Go.Data installations. One instance sends its data (for example, a municipality) and another one receives and gathers it (for example, the national server). This way, the receiver has a consolidated view and nobody needs to enter anything twice.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_CALLOUT_DESC.translation: Before anything is sent, the instance that receives the data must create a client application in "Receive data from servers". LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_1_DESCR.translation: In "Receive data from Servers", create a client application for each instance that will send data, with the type "Go.Data instance". LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_2_DESCR.translation: In "Send data to servers", register the instance that will receive the data: enter its URL and paste the client ID and secret generated in step 1. Use the "Check server" and "Test credentials" buttons to confirm everything is right before saving.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_3_DESCR.translation: In the same form, set an interval for the automatic synchronization, enable "Sync on every change" or synchronize manually with the button in the list. In "Outbreaks to synchronize" you choose which outbreaks to send; empty sends all of them.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_4_DESCR.translation: "Send data to Servers" and "Receive data from Servers" show the latest synchronizations of each side. "Track synchronization" holds the full history, with the direction, the status and, when something goes wrong, the error details.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_DIRECTIO.translation: Does the synchronization go both ways?
No. The data only goes from the sending instance to the receiving one. If both need to send data to each other, each one must register the other as a destination server.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_WHAT_IS_.translation: What is sent in each synchronization?

The first synchronization sends all the data. The next ones send only what was created or updated since the last successful synchronization. When there is nothing new, the synchronization ends as "Up to date".

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_OUTBREAK.translation: Can I send only some outbreaks?

Yes. Choose the outbreaks in "Outbreaks to synchronize", in the server settings, or in the manual synchronization window. When a new outbreak is added to the list, the next synchronization sends all the data of the chosen outbreaks.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_OVERWRIT.translation: Can the synchronization delete or overwrite the receiver's data?
A record is only updated when the received version is newer than the existing one. The receiver's own settings, such as roles, system settings and customized translations, are not changed.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_RECEIVER.translation: Can the receiving instance change the data of the sending instance?

No. If the receiving instance edits a received record, the change stays only there and never goes back to the sender. The sender remains the owner of the record: when it changes that record again, its version replaces the edit made here in the answers that come from it (answers of questions that exist only here are kept). So, to fix received data, ask the sender to fix it at the source, and it will arrive here in the next synchronization. Information that belongs to this instance should be kept in questions that exist only in the questionnaire here.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_FAILED_Q.translation: The synchronization failed. What should I do?

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_FAILED_A.translation: The progress window shows the step that failed and why. The most common causes are the destination server being offline, a wrong URL or invalid or disabled credentials. The full details are in "Track synchronization". If the problem continues, contact the administrator of the destination server.

The same applies to an ignored option, and the other options of the question are imported normally. Nothing is deleted on the instance that sent the data. The mapping is saved, so the question stays ignored in the next synchronizations.

"Review received data" is a step of receiving: it says to which outbreak and to which questions the received data goes. "Track synchronization" is the full history of both sides.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_PENDING_.translation: Why isn't my data being sent?

The destination server decides which outbreaks it receives. In "Send data to Servers > Destination servers", "Approval of the outbreaks" shows what is waiting for approval, what was accepted and what was refused or paused. Only the accepted outbreaks are sent; the others are sent as soon as the destination server accepts or resumes them.
